summary:
MARTIAN is a functional, interactive Mars exploration and mission-planning working model developed by Team MVIT apexcoderz. It integrates 3D Mars visualization, planetary exploration, terrain analysis, route planning, water-resource intelligence, environmental and hazard assessment, habitat resource calculations, scientific research information, location comparison, and mission reporting into one web platform.

The application uses planetary data products and research references, including NASA MGS MOLA MEGDR elevation data and SWIM2 water-ice mapping information. Built using React, JavaScript, Python, FastAPI, and SQLite, MARTIAN connects interactive frontend modules with backend calculations and mission-management features.

The platform demonstrates how planetary datasets and software tools can support early-stage Mars exploration research and mission planning. It is a working student-developed model, with preliminary calculations and outputs that require further scientific validation.

Website: https://martianspace.netlify.app
details:
MARTIAN – Interplanetary Survival Guide is a functional, interactive Mars exploration and mission-planning platform developed by Team MVIT apexcoderz.

The project brings multiple Mars exploration tools together in one web application, including an interactive 3D Mars globe, Mars Explorer, terrain-based route planning, water-resource intelligence, environmental and hazard information, habitat planning, location comparison, science and research information, and mission reports.

MARTIAN integrates NASA MGS MOLA MEGDR elevation data and SWIM2 water-ice mapping information to demonstrate how planetary datasets can support early-stage Mars exploration and mission planning.

The platform uses React and JavaScript for the frontend, Python and FastAPI for backend processing, and SQLite for mission data management. It is deployed online and provides interactive features and downloadable reports.

MARTIAN is a student-developed working model. Its preliminary calculations and outputs are intended for exploration and educational research, not as validated rover-safety or operational mission guidance.

Website: https://martianspace.netlify.app
